1.  Andy and Betsy both live in Mathville. Andy leaves Mathville on his bicycle at 1:30,
    traveling due north at a steady 8 miles per hour. Betsy leaves on her bicycle from the
   same point at 2:30, traveling due east at a steady 12 miles per hour. At what time will
   they be exactly the same distance from their common starting point?

    D    4:15

     E    4:30
